Quick update from infra triage:
- Root cause (prelim): a recent labels migration on 2026-10-12 moved a subset of Medicus project IDs into a new project namespace but the org-tier mapping rule we use for reserved quotas didn't include that new namespace. As a result ~9 project keys fell back to a default minimal quota (50 req/min) while active traffic remained at prior levels (~1k req/min each).
- Observable behavior: immediate 429s for those project keys, client retries escalated to request storms that saturated our edge queues and produced downstream 504s.
- Evidence attached: quota-mapping-export.csv (shows missing mappings), medicus_429_logs_20261018.txt (sample traces).

Immediate mitigation I applied (10:40 PT):
1) Applied a time-limited quota override to affected project IDs to match their prior tier (till 2026-10-19T04:00Z).
2) Tweaked gateway policy to return Retry-After and enforce exponential backoff headers so clients have a chance to back off.
3) Enabled a 60s circuit-breaker on the busiest endpoints to protect model backends from cascading load.

Next steps (inflight):
- Roll back the labels migration or update the org->project mapping permanently (config change in infra).
- Run a sweep to find any other orgs affected by the same label migration logic.
- Postmortem + exec summary once we stabilize.

I'll keep you posted; logs are attached. Let me know if you want me to escalate to SRE on-call.

— Marcus
Principal Infrastructure Engineer

Attachments: quota-mapping-export.csv, medicus_429_logs_20261018.txt
